title: Container Bookings: amount of a late shipping-instruction entry
content:
## Rule
Under the Container Bookings product line, the amount of a late shipping-instruction entry is decided in this order: shipping instructions that were not late book nothing; late instructions within the free allowance on the booking are recorded at 0.00; late instructions outside it are recorded at the tier's late SI fee. The amount is written in USD rounded to two decimal places.

## Decision table
| Received late | Within the free allowance | Entry |
|---|---|---|
| no | not relevant | nothing is booked |
| yes | yes | 0.00 |
| yes | no | the tier's late SI fee |

## Points of judgement
**Is the late SI fee multiplied by the number of containers?** No. The entry outside the allowance is the tier's late SI fee itself, rounded to two decimal places.
